'''Version 1.1.0''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on October 18th 2019.  It was 330.67 KB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

*Changed how the entities are registered into Minecraft for better compatibility
*The parasites now regenerate health each time they kill another entity
*Changed the [[Assimilated Human|Infected Human]] model and texture
*The [[Assimilated Human|Infected Human]] now has a chance to spawn [[Buglin|Lodos]] when hurt
*Added 2 mobs:
*# [[Adapted Summoner|'''Carna''']]: A big creature looking for someone to consume
*# [[Primitive Manducater|'''Hull''']]: The parasite version of a dog, it can move quick and strike fast
